transcript: explain how the bar plugin gets its state
answer: The bar plugin does not read the state file itself. It binds to the shared service, which holds one subscription to the daemon socket and falls back to watching the file only when the socket is unavailable. Every surface reads the same normalized view, so the bar, the pill, the bubble and the panel always agree about what Wisp is doing, and a stale or offline flag shows up everywhere at once instead of in one place.
